newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Sept 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Sept 24.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Sept. 24:
WASHINGTON - Lawyers for Ross Perot sued the Federal Election Commission and a nonprofit, bipartisan commission in a bid to get the Reform Party candidate included in the presidential debates.
WASHINGTON - The presidential candidates are trading shots about the nation's drug problems, but law enforcement officials say the new pattern of drug activity calls for new government strategies.
WASHINGTON - Hillary Rodham Clinton drafted a real estate document that was used by an Arkansas S&L to "deceive" federal regulators in 1986, a federal inspector general concluded.
MOSCOW - News that Russian President Boris Yeltsin's heart ailment is more serious than previously acknowledged has fueled a fresh and intense struggle for primacy among possible successors.
LONDON - British media are consumed with story of a Roman Catholic bishop who ran off to live with the woman he loves, to the dismay of the other woman whose child he allegedly fathered 15 years ago.
